findings.title: Gate can be satisfied with fewer than three receipts by editing `manifest.agents`
findings.evidence: [scripts/security-team.mjs:49-50](C:/Users/SuperAdmin/.vscode/SurfaceTrace/scripts/security-team.mjs#L49) writes the expected agent list into the manifest, but [scripts/security-team.mjs:64-76](C:/Users/SuperAdmin/.vscode/SurfaceTrace/scripts/security-team.mjs#L64) trusts `manifest.agents` when deciding which receipts must exist and never verifies that it still matches `TEAMS[manifest.team]`. Because `agents` is not part of the scope hash at [scripts/security-team.mjs:47-48](C:/Users/SuperAdmin/.vscode/SurfaceTrace/scripts/security-team.mjs#L47), a tampered manifest can drop agents and still reach PASS with fewer than three receipts.
findings.recommendation: Bind the expected agent roster into the scope hash or explicitly compare `manifest.agents` against the canonical team list before reading receipts.

findings.title: `PASS` does not require successful checks or any findings, only evidence strings
findings.evidence: [scripts/security-team.mjs:71-73](C:/Users/SuperAdmin/.vscode/SurfaceTrace/scripts/security-team.mjs#L71) only checks `receipt.status === "PASS"` and that each check has a non-empty `evidence` field. The receipt schema allows `checks[].result` values of `PASS`, `FAIL`, or `NOT_TESTED` and allows `findings` to be empty at [security-teams/receipt-schema.json:11-39](C:/Users/SuperAdmin/.vscode/SurfaceTrace/security-teams/receipt-schema.json#L11), so a receipt can report internally failed or unperformed checks while still satisfying the gate.
findings.recommendation: Validate the full receipt schema and require every check to be `PASS` or otherwise enforce a rule tying `checks[].result` and `findings` to the final receipt status.

checks.name: manifest roster integrity
checks.evidence: The gate trusts `manifest.agents` instead of recomputing the canonical team roster.

checks.name: receipt PASS semantics
checks.evidence: The gate accepts any non-empty `checks[].evidence` values and ignores `checks[].result` and `findings`.

limitations: Passive source review only; no network traffic or runtime execution was performed.
Findings are based on the reviewed source paths above and not on live receipts or modified artifacts.
